rationale: The agent submitted an exchange without authenticating the user, without confirming the order-changing action beforehand, and without demonstrating that it checked for a suitable clicky, RGB, full-size keyboard as requested. It unilaterally proceeded with only the thermostat exchange and stated a specific refund amount ($13.46) without tool-supported evidence in the conversation. These violate the policy requirements to authenticate, confirm before writes, and avoid unsupported information. While it acted on the referenced order, the lack of authentication and confirmation, plus missing steps for the keyboard request, mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
